svg.title: FIG-14 U575 TZEN=1: no-OS synchronous GPIO dual-domain reference Independent Secure / NS images, not default TZEN0 Platform
svg.desc: External boot / provisioning owner 2 MiB, bank1 Secure, bank2 NS pages Supplies layout/vectors/option bytes; mechanism never writes option bytes; Secure cold owner: no active worlds / IRQ / DMA SRAM1 Secure; zero future NS SRAM3 before declassification GTZC/MPCBB + SAU 3 spans + NS MPU Read/clear actual 8 or 16 regions, lock and read back; Any error after admission: FAILED + effects Irreversible attribution retained until reset; no rollback; READY -> RUNNING -> actual CMSE entry NS unprivileged Thread; unexpected return fail-stops; NonSecure: static mappings, no RTOS / handlers / autonomous masters; NS caller + explicit NS RAM request/output Fixed world principal; do not trust message task IDs; NS receives synchronous return Final access to input/output storage has exited; Secure privileged Thread: exclusive synchronous gateway; Actual SG: validate NS caller / Thread / RUNNING Save and mask NS interrupts; Constrain explicit NS RAM span + CMSE unprivileged check Synchronous pin under static attribution and no concurrency; Bounded input copy to Secure snapshot Fixed PC7 grant, output spans prevalidated; UserIoBroker: scalar GPIO read / set-reset No arbitrary MMIO / callbacks / asynchronous DMA grant; Final output copy -> unpin -> restore NS mask Cleanup never replays GPIO; impossible release failure terminates; Actual prerequisites and parameters before entry; Read back all permissions / locks / vectors; Failure after acquiring effects; Enter NS unprivileged Thread; Synchronous SG call; Actual principal and serialization prerequisites; Pin succeeded; a check alone does not pin; Authorized and output prevalidation passed; Single result, no automatic replay; Synchronous return
